mistakes.subject: 英语
mistakes.wrong: she have a cat and a dog
mistakes.right: she has a cat and a dog
mistakes.note: she/he/it 是三单，have 要变成 has

mistakes.subject: 英语
mistakes.right: They go to eat a hamburger / hamburgers
mistakes.note: hamburger 可数名词，单数前加 a 或变复数

mistakes.subject: 英语
mistakes.wrong: I want a cup of offer（译：我需要一杯咖啡）
mistakes.right: I want a cup of coffee.（我想要一杯咖啡）
mistakes.note: offer=提供/提议，不是咖啡；coffee=咖啡。且 I want 对应「我想要」而非「我需要」(need)
